scope: Restore original 12.66 kV, topology, physical R/X and background P/Q. Replay frozen no-storage and existing ESS-TES schedules. Do not resize the AIDC, reinforce lines, change tap settings or reoptimize dispatch.
comparison_note: The existing joint schedule was optimized against an exogenous 25.5 MW PCC cap, not this network. Its replay is a compatibility check, not a network-aware optimal schedule.
baseline_note: Under the retained 0.95 lower bound the no-AIDC background may already be infeasible. Report a null hosting boundary in that event, not zero capacity. The source-case 0.9-1.1 bounds are a separately labelled diagnostic only.
